lines: Jury on the frozen build: spring gets 3 of 15 votes for photo or film against 10 of 10 on the controls and summer gets 7 of 15 against 8 of 10. Both fail
Summer's motion scores 7 (4 in its first round): the base still changes in plain sight during the shake and the shake lacks weight
Decisions 88 and 89: fall's leaf count goes from 16000 to 10000 and the background lights cross through the whole swap window
Next: fall's stills and the last two gates. Third freeze at 08:32 for each season's last round and the first round of the changes
phase 4: 7.35 h used of its 9.50 h box
allowance (before the review): 29.63 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Fall at the landing with 10000 leaves: approved left and a builder's draft right. The tree and the roof now read through the storm
Fall's base: approved above and a builder's draft below. Grey leather on the right flank and a wax rim with thin runs
Summer at rest: a builder's draft left and approved right. Fireflies are now small soft points. The oval at the top of the glass is an open item
